description.value: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing Company is Squamish's original craft brewery, founded in 1996 with the help of John Mitchell — the 'grandfather of micro-brewing' — and has since won awards at the Canadian Brewing Awards, North American Brewer's Awards, and BC Beer Awards. The 20-room boutique inn occupies the upper floor of the brewpub building in Downtown Squamish, giving guests immediate access to craft beer and a full kitchen without leaving the property. Pet-friendly rooms are available, and the location puts guests within walking distance of the Stawamus Chief and Sea to Sky trail networks.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (6 spaces, covered) at 56m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and active: current event listings, hours, and contact details all matching OSM data (address 37801 Cleveland Ave, Squamish, BC V8B 0A7; phone 604-892-2603). The rooms page states all room types include 'access to Howe Sound Brewing and Brewpub,' confirming on-site evening food. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, pump, Wi-Fi (website does not corroborate OSM's internet_access=wlan tag), or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible boutique hotel and brewpub in Downtown Squamish — a natural stop for Sea to Sky touring cyclists.
